BiblicalUsage: Prosagoge means access, admission into the presence of someone greater. Paul says we have access by faith into this grace wherein we stand, and that through Christ both Jew and Gentile have access by one Spirit unto the Father, with boldness and confidence.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe access is the heart of the gospel: I do not have to wait outside, hoping God might notice me. Christ has opened the door, and I come in boldly, not because I am worthy, but because He is.
